questions.question: One weakness of boundary value analysis and equivalence partitioning is
options: they do not explore combinations of input circumstances
they explore combinations of input circumstances
options_en: they do not explore combinations of input circumstances
they explore combinations of input circumstances
questions.question_ar: من نقاط ضعف تحليل القيم الحدودية وتقسيم فئات التكافؤ:
options_ar: they do not explore combinations of input circumstances
they explore combinations of input circumstances
questions.explanation: One major weakness of boundary value analysis and equivalence class partitioning is that they do not explore combinations of input conditions. Both methods test variables largely in isolation under the single-fault assumption, missing defects caused by variable interactions.
questions.explanation_ar: نقطة الضعف الجوهرية في تحليل القيم الحدية وتجزئة التكافؤ هي إهمال التفاعل بين الشروط المركبة، حيث تفترض كل طريقة فحص المتغير بمعزل عن بقية المتغيرات.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.27; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: In cause effect graphing technique, cause and effect are related to
questions.question_ar: في تقنية cause effect graphing، السبب والنتيجة يرتبطان بـ:
questions.explanation: In cause-effect graphing, cause and effect represent input condition and output action (or state change) respectively. A cause is a distinct input condition or equivalence class; an effect is an observable output or internal transformation.
questions.explanation_ar: في تقنية مخطط السبب والنتيجة (Cause-Effect Graphing)، يمثل «السبب» شرط الإدخال (Input)، ويمثل «الأثر» الإجراء أو المخرج الناتج (Output).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.28; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: DD Path graph is called as
questions.explanation: A DD path graph is a decision-to-decision path graph. It reduces the flow graph by combining runs of sequential nodes into single nodes, keeping the decision nodes.
questions.explanation_ar: DD = Decision to Decision. الرسم يدمج العقد المتتابعة ويُبقي عقد القرار. الفخ: لا تفكّ الاختصار إلى Design أو Defect أو Destination.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.29; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

any path through the DD Path graph that introduces one and only one new set of processing statements or new conditions
questions.explanation: An independent path is any path through the DD path graph that introduces at least one new set of processing statements or new conditions.
questions.explanation_ar: المسار المستقل يضيف على الأقل مجموعة جديدة من تعليمات المعالجة أو شروطاً جديدة. الفخ: at most وone and only one خياران خاطئان.

questions.question: Cyclomatic complexity is developed by
questions.explanation: Cyclomatic complexity was developed by T. J. McCabe. The deck introduces it as McCabe's cyclomatic metric, V(G) = e - n + 2P.
questions.explanation_ar: مقياس التعقيد الدوري من وضع مكيب (T. J. McCabe).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.31; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Cyclomatic complexity is denoted by
options: V(G) = number of regions of the graph
options_en: V(G) = number of regions of the graph
options_ar: V(G) = number of regions of the graph
questions.explanation: All three formulations are valid: (a) V(G) = e - n + 2P, (b) V(G) = π + 1, where π is the number of predicate nodes, and (c) V(G) = the number of regions of the flow graph.
questions.explanation_ar: الطرق الثلاث صحيحة: e-n+2P (حيث P عدد المكونات المتصلة)، وπ+1 (حيث π عدد عقد القرار)، وعدد المناطق. لذلك الإجابة (d).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.32; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: The equation V(G) = Π + 1 of cyclomatic complexity is applicable only if every predicate node has
questions.question_ar: المعادلة V(G) = Π + 1 للتعقيد السيكلوماتي تنطبق فقط إذا كان لكل عقدة شرط predicate:
questions.explanation: The equation V(G) = π + 1 applies only if every predicate node has two outgoing edges. A node with three or more outgoing edges breaks the simple +1 rule.
questions.explanation_ar: صيغة π+1 تصح فقط إذا كان لكل عقدة قرار مخرجان اثنان بالضبط.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.33; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: The size of the graph matrix is
options: number of edges in the flow graph
number of nodes in the flow graph
number of paths in the flow graph
number of independent paths in the flow graph
options_en: number of edges in the flow graph
number of nodes in the flow graph
number of paths in the flow graph
number of independent paths in the flow graph
questions.question_ar: حجم مصفوفة الرسم graph matrix هو:
options_ar: number of edges in the flow graph
number of nodes in the flow graph
number of paths in the flow graph
number of independent paths in the flow graph
questions.explanation: The size of a graph matrix is an $N \times N$ square matrix, where $N$ is the number of nodes in the flow graph. Each row and column corresponds directly to a node.
questions.explanation_ar: مصفوفة الرسم البياني (Graph Matrix) هي مصفوفة مربعة بأبعاد $N \times N$، حيث يمثل $N$ عدد العقد الإجمالي في مخطط تدفق البرنامج.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.34; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (B) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Every node is represented by
options: one row and one column in graph matrix
two rows and two columns in graph matrix
one row and two columns in graph matrix
options_en: one row and one column in graph matrix
two rows and two columns in graph matrix
one row and two columns in graph matrix
options_ar: one row and one column in graph matrix
two rows and two columns in graph matrix
one row and two columns in graph matrix
questions.explanation: In a graph matrix, every node is represented by exactly one row and one column. The entry at $(i, j)$ indicates whether a directed edge connects node $i$ to node $j$.
questions.explanation_ar: في مصفوفة الرسم، تُمثل كل عقدة بصف واحد وعمود واحد حصراً؛ وتُسجل التوصيلات بين العقدة $i$ والعقدة $j$ في الخلية المتقاطعة.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.35; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Cyclomatic complexity is equal to
questions.explanation: Cyclomatic complexity $V(G)$ is equal to the number of linearly independent paths through the program flow graph. It establishes the upper bound for the number of test cases required to achieve complete branch coverage.
questions.explanation_ar: التعقيد الدوري $V(G)$ يساوي رياضياً عدد المسارات المستقلة خطياً (Number of independent paths) في فضاء المسارات الأساسي للبرنامج.

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.36; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (A) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: Data flow testing is related to
questions.question_ar: اختبار تدفق البيانات data flow testing يرتبط بـ:
questions.explanation: Data flow testing is not related to data flow diagrams, E-R diagrams, or data dictionaries. Data flow testing is a structural (white-box) technique focusing on the lifecycle of program variables (definitions, uses, and kills) along paths in control flow graphs.
questions.explanation_ar: فحص تدفق البيانات (Data Flow Testing) هو فحص صندوق أبيض لمسارات المتغيرات (DEF/USE) في كود البرنامج، ولا علاقة له بمخططات تدفق البيانات (DFD) أو مخططات الكيانات (ERD).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.37; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (D) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.

questions.question: In data flow testing, objective is to find
options: all dc-paths that are not du-paths
all du-paths that are not dc-paths
options_en: all dc-paths that are not du-paths
all du-paths that are not dc-paths
questions.question_ar: في اختبار تدفق البيانات، الهدف هو إيجاد:
options_ar: all dc-paths that are not du-paths
all du-paths that are not dc-paths
questions.explanation: In data flow testing, a key objective is to uncover data anomalies, which requires examining all du-paths that are not definition-clear (dc) paths. If a variable is re-defined along a path before being used, an anomaly or redundant definition exists.
questions.explanation_ar: الهدف في فحص تدفق البيانات هو كشف التشوهات (Data anomalies) باختبار المسارات التي يعاد فيها تعريف المتغير دون استخدامه (المسارات التي ليست dc-paths نظيفة).

source.reference: Aggarwal & Singh, Software Engineering (3rd ed.), MCQ 8.38; publisher key p. 499

note.ar: قوبل السؤال مع مفتاح الناشر المطبوع.
note.en: CONFIRMED against publisher key (C) in Aggarwal & Singh (3rd ed.) p. 499.
